prior_medium_article.author: Hawkar (Oleksandr Ahapov)

relevant_predecessor_claims: P=NP and P≠NP beliefs were used as agent meta-goals to diversify strategies.
The Genesis ecosystem connected evolutionary search, social learning and hyperparameter optimization.
The earlier work treated P versus NP as an architectural meta-goal and metaphor, not as a proof.

existing_sat_line.relationship: The P–N Junction work does not start from an empty SAT solver; it reinterprets and extends an existing JANUS SAT research line.

research_question.ru: Можно ли представить поиск решения как перенос информационных носителей между областями предложенных состояний и неудовлетворённых ограничений, а затем получить воспроизводимое преимущество, не пряча экспоненциальную цену во времени, энергии, точности, памяти, связи или предобработке?
research_question.en: Can solution search be modeled as information-carrier transport between proposed states and unsatisfied constraints, producing a reproducible advantage without hiding exponential cost in time, energy, precision, memory, communication, or preprocessing?

formal_mapping.junction_potential: weighted pressure created by persistent unsatisfied clauses
formal_mapping.local_depletion_region: a recurring local basin with no improvement
formal_mapping.barrier_energy: accumulated stagnation, repeated unsatisfied signatures and charged clauses
formal_mapping.tunneling: controlled acceptance of locally harmful flips as barrier energy rises
formal_mapping.avalanche_breakdown: tested coherent multi-variable flip packet across a basin boundary

hypotheses.H0: After fair resource normalization, the Junction mechanisms provide no robust advantage over established local-search baselines.
hypotheses.H1: Persistent clause charge and directed pressure reduce the number of state transitions needed to solve some SAT distributions near a phase boundary.
hypotheses.H2: An adaptive depletion-escape mechanism improves large/deep-basin cases without degrading small/shallow-basin cases.
hypotheses.forbidden_inference: Success on finite planted SAT samples is not evidence that P=NP and is not a polynomial-time worst-case proof.

process_log.name: Concept formation
process_log.event: The P/NP terminology was deliberately linked to p-type and n-type semiconductor dynamics as a new computational hypothesis rather than a historical claim.
process_log.result: A computational junction was defined with candidate states, information holes, potential, carrier motion and recombination.

process_log.name: Reuse of JANUS SAT foundation
process_log.event: Existing Janus Demiurge SAT swarm work was identified as the experimental foundation rather than rebuilding a trivial solver.
process_log.result: WalkSAT-like violated-clause selection and flip-gain logic were used as the baseline family.

process_log.name: Junction v0.1 simulation
process_log.result: The Junction method solved all tested instances and reduced median solved steps strongly on the tested 3-SAT points, while Python overhead remained significant.

process_log.name: Local depletion problem identified
process_log.event: The first model lacked a sufficiently selective mechanism for leaving local depletion regions.
process_log.result: A new test was designed around adaptive barrier accumulation, thermal tunneling, tabu memory and coherent avalanche pulses.

process_log.name: Junction Tunnel v0.2 simulation
process_log.result: The escape mechanism improved the largest tested 3-SAT point and modestly improved selected 5-SAT points, but over-triggered and regressed on the smallest tested 3-SAT point.

junction_v0_1.interpretation: Logical-step reduction was observed, especially for tested 3-SAT, but wall-clock advantage was inconsistent because the prototype recomputed weighted effects expensively.

derived_observations: At tested 3-SAT n=64, Junction Tunnel used 42 median solved steps versus 155 for WalkSAT, approximately 3.69× fewer.
At tested 3-SAT n=64, Junction Tunnel reduced median steps from 55 to 42 versus Junction base, approximately 23.6%.
At tested 3-SAT n=32, Junction Tunnel regressed from 38 to 48 median steps and averaged 3.3125 escapes, indicating over-triggering.
The negative n=32 result is retained as evidence against unconditional escape activation.

limitations_and_confounds: All recorded instances in these two simulations were planted satisfiable instances; no UNSAT certification was tested.
Sample sizes were small: 8 or 16 instances per configuration.
Problem sizes ended at 64 variables; this is insufficient for asymptotic conclusions.
Each method used a deterministic but different solver RNG seed; initial assignments were not explicitly matched across methods.
The implementations were not equally optimized. Junction flip scoring repeatedly scanned clauses and therefore carried extra Python overhead.
Median steps count state transitions, not total primitive operations, memory traffic, energy, precision or communication.
No standard SAT competition benchmark suite or adversarial structured family was used.
No confidence intervals, hypothesis tests or multiple-comparison correction were calculated.
No physical ESP32 swarm execution occurred in these two recorded simulations.

required_next_experiment: Use identical generated instances and identical initial assignments for every solver.
Separate algorithmic random streams from instance generation and publish all seeds.
Add known SAT and known UNSAT benchmark families.
Increase n and trials until confidence intervals and scaling fits become meaningful.
Implement incremental occurrence lists and O(affected clauses) updates for every solver.
Measure wall time, primitive clause touches, RAM, energy and, for the swarm, message count and bytes.
Run ablations: charge only, momentum only, tabu only, thermal only, avalanche only and full model.
Compare against stronger modern SAT baselines, not only WalkSAT.
Pre-register success and failure thresholds before the next main run.
reject_or_reduce_claim_if: The step advantage disappears with matched initialization or stronger baselines.
Resource-normalized cost grows exponentially despite fewer recorded flips.
The escape mechanism improves only hand-selected planted distributions.
Regression on small instances cannot be removed without tuning on the test set.

next_mechanism.name: Adaptive Depletion Depth Detector
next_mechanism.purpose: Trigger tunneling only when a basin is deep and recurrent, preserving the n=64 benefit while preventing the n=32 over-triggering.

proposed_roles.HOLOCRON: display, telemetry, event log and recombination witness

hardware_transition_plan.boundary: ESP32-S3 contains semiconductor junctions physically, but firmware cannot directly control individual internal p–n junctions. The first hardware test implements the computational model on top of the devices and must not be described as direct transistor-junction control.

artifact_integrity.note: The committed v0.2 results.json contains summary rows; the simulator regenerates per-trial detail on rerun.

claim_boundary.ru: Артефакт фиксирует возникновение гипотезы, реализацию и два программных прогона. Он не доказывает P=NP, не доказывает полиномиальную сложность, не утверждает физическую тождественность классов P/NP и p/n-полупроводников и не скрывает отрицательный результат на 3-SAT n=32.
claim_boundary.en: This artifact records hypothesis formation, implementation and two software runs. It does not prove P=NP, polynomial complexity, or physical identity between complexity classes P/NP and p/n semiconductors, and it preserves the negative 3-SAT n=32 result.

ru: Не доказывай победу метафорой — заставь её пройти измерение.
Неудовлетворённое ограничение становится дыркой только тогда, когда это определение даёт проверяемый алгоритм.
Локальная обеднённая область требует не случайного перезапуска, а измеряемого механизма выхода.
Отрицательный результат не удаляется: он показывает, где поле лжёт.
P=NP остаётся открытым вопросом; Junction остаётся проверяемой гипотезой.
en: Do not prove victory by metaphor; make it pass measurement.
An unsatisfied constraint becomes a hole only when that definition yields a testable algorithm.
A local depletion region requires a measurable escape mechanism, not an unexplained restart.
A negative result is not deleted; it shows where the field lies.
P=NP remains open; Junction remains a testable hypothesis.
